structured.answer: It's savings where the employer adds money on top of my salary and I put in some too; after 6 years from the first deposit I can take it out with no tax, and it seems worth having because the employer adds much more than I put in — but the money is invested in a 'מסלול', maybe shares, with fees up to 2% a year, so I'd ask my son or the bank which track is safe before signing.
